# How to Contribute to Ultra-Dex

## Quick Contribution (5 minutes)

### 1. Fix a Typo

```bash
# Find typo in docs
# Click "Edit" on GitHub
# Submit PR
```

### 2. Add an Example

```bash
# Copy examples/auth-workflow.md
# Modify for your use case
# Submit PR to examples/
```

### 3. Improve an Agent

```bash
# Copy .agents/backend.md
# Add missing quality check
# Add better example
# Submit PR
```

## Medium Contribution (30 minutes)

### Create a New Agent

```bash
# Copy .agents/MY_CUSTOM_AGENT.md
# Fill in your specialty
# Test with real project
# Submit PR to .agents/
```

### Write a Workflow

```bash
# Copy examples/auth-workflow.md
# Document your process
# Add code snippets
# Submit PR to examples/
```

## Large Contribution (2+ hours)

### Add Industry Guide

- Fintech compliance
- Healthcare (HIPAA)
- E-commerce patterns
- SaaS best practices

### Create Video Tutorial

- Record screen
- Show agent usage
- Explain workflow
- Upload & share

## Submit Your Contribution

1. Fork repo
2. Create branch: `feat/your-feature`
3. Make changes
4. Test locally
5. Submit PR with:
   - Clear title
   - Description
   - Example usage

## Get Recognized!

Contributors get:

- Name in README
- Contributor badge
- Community thanks
- Swag (when available)

## Questions?

Open an issue or discussion!
